description.short_caption: Severe crusted and hyperkeratotic lesions on the hand and forearm.
description.detailed_description: This clinical photograph shows a hand and forearm with extensive crusting, hyperkeratosis, and scaling. The lesions are thickened and yellowish, with areas of fissuring and deformity. The involvement appears severe, with significant disruption of normal skin architecture. The condition is likely chronic, given the extent of keratin buildup and deformity.
